title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries

paragraphs.en: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. Applying the protocol to public framework repairs, we confirm 18 evidence-path failures across 11 LLM or agent safety project groups and four implementation ecosystems. Nine are established-boundary repairs, eight are new-surface policy-coverage gaps, and one is a boundary-only evidence case. Fourteen reach E1 enforcement boundaries: seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence. The remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. The cases form carrier, adapter, authority, and surface families and show how ordinary application behavior can remain intact while a safety-specific evidence path misses its decision. Exact revisions, deterministic outcomes, negative controls, and a frozen prospective audit document the confirmation rule. Monitor assumptions therefore need regression tests at the schemas, streams, tools, and adapters that frameworks evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）应用依赖运行时监控器，用于检查工具调用、追踪信息、流数据、检测器输出和验证器输入。 这造成了一个接口可靠性问题：框架的某条路径可能仍在正常运行，但相关政策性证据却从未到达其决策节点。 在一个典型案例中，正则表达式检测器返回了匹配结果，但框架在该结果到达阻断决策之前便将其搁置了。 这与越狱攻击或检测器错误不同，因为相关证据已被识别，但却与执行机制脱节。 我们通过“金丝雀合同”研究这种修复边界特征：即父级/固定确认单元，仅对变更后的证据表面注入已知负载，并记录监控可见性与后续决策，以分析作用边界案例。 将这一协议应用于公开框架的修复中，我们确认了 11 个大语言模型或智能体安全项目团队以及 4 个实现生态系统中共存在 18 处证据路径故障。 其中 9 处为已确立边界的修复，8 处为新表面的政策覆盖缺口，另有 1 处为仅涉及边界的证据案例。 14 处案例触及了 E1 执行边界：包括 7 个原生动作结果、6 个配置的执行边界以及 1 个合成消费者后果。 其余案例则影响了验证器、安全提示或可观察性通道。 这些案例构成了载体、适配器、授权方和表面等类别，并揭示了普通应用行为可能保持完整，而特定于安全机制的证据路径却未能触发决策的情况。 精确的修订、确定性的结果、阴性对照以及一份冻结的未来审计文件共同记录了确认规则。 因此，监控器假设需要在框架不断演进的架构、流数据、工具和适配器层面进行回归测试。

paragraphs.en: A guardrail in a modern LLM application is rarely just a prompt wrapper. Before it blocks, routes, redacts, or reports, it may read request objects, tool-call arguments, stream events, generated files, detector outputs, or verifier inputs. Safety therefore depends on structured evidence that sits between the prompt and the final response ( Inan et al. 2023 ; Han et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在现代大语言模型应用中，护栏很少仅仅是一个提示词包装器。 在实施拦截、路由、删除或报告之前，它可能会读取请求对象、工具调用参数、流式事件、生成的文件、检测器输出或验证器输入。 因此，安全性取决于位于提示词与最终响应之间的结构化证据（Inan et al. 2023；Han et al. 2024；Wang et al. 2025）。

paragraphs.en: A reproduced NeMo Guardrails repair shows the problem in miniature. The regex detector returned a structured positive result with is_match=true . The parent framework still allowed the output, because that positive result was never mapped to the block decision. The fixed revision added the missing output mapping, and the same canary was blocked. Nothing here calls for a stronger jailbreak prompt or a better regex. The detector had seen the evidence; the framework had dropped it before enforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 一次修复后的 NeMo Guardrails 演示了该问题的微型版本。 正则表达式检测器返回了一个结构化的阳性结果，其中 is_match=true。 父框架仍然允许该输出，因为那个阳性结果从未被映射到阻止决策上。 修复后的版本添加了缺失的输出映射，于是同样的测试用例被阻止了。 这里没有任何内容需要更强的越狱提示或更好的正则表达式。 检测器已经看到了证据；但框架在执行前就将其忽略了。

paragraphs.en: The NeMo case is only one instance of a broader software problem. Request schemas change, tool-call representations expand, multimodal fields appear, streaming surfaces are added, and policy adapters are refactored. Agent and tool-use systems make these surfaces part of ordinary execution ( Yao et al. 2022 ; Schick et al. 2023 ; Qin et al. 2023 ) . A monitor can stay configured and stay in the loop while the evidence it relies on moves to a new field, loses metadata, reaches a different adapter, or is materialized only after the safety check. We use monitor-validity failure for the observable parent/fixed repair contrast and reserve monitor-validity drift for its longitudinal working-to-failing subtype.
paragraphs.zh: NeMo 案例只是更广泛软件问题中的一个实例。 请求模式会变化，工具调用表示会扩展，多模态字段会出现，流式传输接口会被添加，策略适配器也会被重构。 智能体与工具使用系统将这些接口纳入了常规执行流程（Yao 等人，2022；Schick 等人，2023；Qin 等人，2023）。 在依赖的证据转移到新字段、丢失元数据、到达不同适配器，或仅在安全检测之后才被生成时，监控器仍能保持配置并持续参与流程。 我们将“监控器有效性失效”用于可观察到的父级/固定修复对比，而将“监控器有效性漂移”保留用于其从运行到失效的纵向子类型。

sents.zh: NeMo 案例只是更广泛软件问题中的一个实例。

sents.en: We use monitor-validity failure for the observable parent/fixed repair contrast and reserve monitor-validity drift for its longitudinal working-to-failing subtype.
sents.zh: 我们将“监控器有效性失效”用于可观察到的父级/固定修复对比，而将“监控器有效性漂移”保留用于其从运行到失效的纵向子类型。

paragraphs.en: That failure is easy to miss when the problem is framed as another jailbreak or guardrail benchmark ( Wei et al. 2023 ; Mazeika et al. 2024 ; Zhan et al. 2024 ; Debenedetti et al. 2024 ; Andriushchenko et al. 2024 ) . Those evaluations ask whether unsafe behavior can be elicited or recognized through a specified interface. Our question is different: once evidence is recognized, does the exercised framework path carry it to the policy boundary? A strong detector, policy DSL, verifier, or LLM-as-judge component cannot protect a reproduced boundary when the parent path does not deliver the evidence or positive result it was designed to use.
paragraphs.zh: 当问题被框架为另一个越狱或护栏基准时，这种失败很容易被忽视（Wei et al. 2023；Mazeika et al. 2024；Zhan et al. 2024；Debenedetti et al. 2024；Andriushchenko et al. 2024）。 这些评估旨在探究是否可以通过指定的接口引发或识别不安全行为。 我们的问题则不同：一旦证据被识别，所采用的框架路径是否会将其传递到策略边界？ 如果父路径未能传递其设计用于使用的证据或积极结果，那么强大的检测器、策略 DSL、验证器或 LLM-作为-裁判组件也无法保护被复用的边界。

paragraphs.en: Source diffs and issue reports are not enough to confirm this miss. The parent revision must already have an intended boundary, a deterministic payload must cross the changed surface, and the parent and fixed revisions must differ in visibility or decision behavior. We use canary contracts as the confirmation unit. Each contract places a known policy-relevant payload only on the changed evidence surface and records monitor visibility together with downstream decision behavior when the case claims an action boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭源差异和问题报告不足以确认此次遗漏。 父版本必须已经存在一个预期的边界，一个确定性的负载必须穿越变更的表面，并且父版本与修复后的版本在可见性或决策行为上必须存在差异。 我们将“金丝雀合同”用作确认单元。 每个合同仅在变更的证据表面上放置一个已知与策略相关的负载，并在案例声称存在动作边界时，记录监控可见性与下游的决策行为。

paragraphs.en: Using canary contracts, we study 18 confirmed repair-boundary cases across 11 framework project groups and four implementation ecosystems. We keep the evidence strata explicit: 9 are established-boundary repair cases, eight are new-surface validity gaps, and one remains boundary-only evidence. We also keep reproduction strength separate from impact: 14 cases reach E1 enforcement boundaries, comprising seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence, while the remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. We organize the cases into four dependency families, depending on where the hidden assumption broke: the payload carrier, the detector-to-action adapter, the authority among competing channels, or the monitored surface itself.
paragraphs.zh: 通过金丝雀合约，我们研究了 11 个框架项目组和 4 个实现生态系统中的 18 个已确认的修复边界案例。 我们明确保留了证据分层：9 个是已确立边界的修复案例，8 个是新表面的有效性缺口，还有 1 个仅保留为边界证据。 我们还把可复现性强度与影响区分开来：14 个案例达到了 E1 执行边界，其中包括 7 个原生操作结果、6 个配置的执行边界和 1 个合成消费者后果，而其余案例则影响了验证器、安全提示或可观察性通道。 我们将这些案例组织为四个依赖族，具体取决于隐藏假设失效的位置：载荷载体、检测器到操作适配器、竞争通道间的权限关系，或是受监控的表面本身。

paragraphs.en: This framing also fixes the unit of evaluation. We do not ask whether a model is unsafe in general. We ask whether a specific safety boundary still receives the evidence it was built to use. That distinction matters for regression testing: the failing object is often a schema, adapter, stream, or callback rather than a prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 这种框架也确定了评估的单位。 我们并不询问模型是否普遍不安全。 我们询问的是，某个特定的安全边界是否仍然能够获得其构建时用于依赖的证据。 这种区别对回归测试很重要：出问题的对象通常是模式、适配器、流或回调，而不是提示本身。

sents.zh: 我们并不询问模型是否普遍不安全。

sents.zh: 我们询问的是，某个特定的安全边界是否仍然能够获得其构建时用于依赖的证据。

paragraphs.en: We provide a case-level corpus of 18 repair-boundary confirmations across 11 framework project groups, with exact revisions, deterministic canaries, and explicit evidence, impact, subtype, and oracle records.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一个案例级语料库，其中包含来自 11 个框架项目组的 18 项修复边界确认，并附有精确的修订内容、确定性金丝雀测试以及明确的证据、影响、子类型和神谕记录。

paragraphs.en: We organize the cases into four structural failure families that explain how hidden evidence-to-decision assumptions break under framework evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些案例归为四类结构性失效模式，用以说明在框架演化过程中，隐藏的证据-决策假设是如何被打破的。

paragraphs.en: We use canary contracts as safety-specific differential regression-test templates, and we report a five-case runnable diagnostic comparison of full canary contracts with partial checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将金丝雀合约用作专门针对安全性的差异回归测试模板，并报告了完整金丝雀合约与部分检查之间的可运行诊断对比的五种情况。

paragraphs.en: We treat a runtime monitor as any component that observes framework state and can affect a safety-relevant decision. The state may be a message, tool call, stream delta, trace metadata field, detector result, provider metadata object, or artifact path. The decision may block a request, redact output, interrupt a tool call, route a filter result, cap automatic tool execution, or produce a verifier finding. The important dependency is structural: the policy boundary only works if it still sees the runtime representation that carries policy-relevant state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将运行时监控器视为任何能够观察框架状态并对安全性相关决策产生影响的组件。 该状态可能是一条消息、工具调用、流增量、追踪元数据字段、检测器结果、提供者元数据对象或工件路径。 该决策可能阻止请求、编辑输出、中断工具调用、路由过滤结果、限制自动工具执行，或生成验证器发现结果。 关键依赖关系是结构性的：只有当策略边界仍能观察到承载策略相关状态的运行时表示时，它才能有效运作。

paragraphs.en: Monitor validity is relative to the representation and routing path that a policy boundary actually uses. We empirically study repair-boundary failures: in a reproduced parent revision, a policy-relevant canary is absent from the monitor-visible evidence or fails to reach the expected decision; in the fixed revision, the same canary reaches the corresponding visibility or decision oracle. This two-point contrast establishes a failing parent and repaired child, not an earlier working revision.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性的监控相对于策略边界实际使用的表示和路由路径而言是相对的。 我们通过实证研究修复边界的故障：在一个复现的父版本中，与策略相关的金丝雀要么未出现在监控可见的证据中，要么未能达到预期的决策；而在修复后的版本中，同一个金丝雀则能到达相应的可见性或决策预言机。 这种两点对比确立了一个失败的父版本和一个修复后的子版本，而非一个早期正常运行的版本。

paragraphs.zh: 例如，请求护栏可能会检查消息字段中的用户文本，而受支持的路径则通过 input 传递与策略相关的负载。 即使护栏接收到空或过时的视图，应用程序路径仍然可以正常完成。 在其他情况下，证据会被保留，但检测器结果会中断、跳过已配置的挂钩，或在决策边界之前选择了错误的权限。

paragraphs.en: The failure is silent in this mechanical sense. The changed framework path need not crash, and the monitor need not disappear from configuration. Instead, policy-relevant state crosses a dependency boundary that the monitor treats as complete. For a given monitor, only part of the framework state is visible: message fields, tool-call objects, stream chunks, detector outputs, callback arguments, or verifier inputs. When several fields describe the same event, the monitor also depends on which field the framework treats as controlling, such as free-text content or structured tool-call metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 从机械意义上说，这种故障是静默的。 更改后的框架路径不必崩溃，监控器也不必从配置中消失。 相反，与策略相关的状态会跨越一个依赖边界，而监控器会将该边界视为完整的。 对于给定的监控器，只有框架状态的一部分是可见的：消息字段、工具调用对象、流片段、检测器输出、回调参数或验证器输入。 当多个字段描述同一事件时，监控器还取决于框架将哪个字段视为控制字段，例如自由文本内容或结构化的工具调用元数据。

A canary contract tests that contrast by placing the same payload on the exercised surface and checking visibility and, where applicable, decision behavior.

paragraphs.en: A confirmed repair-boundary case compares a parent revision and a fixed revision around a public repair. The relevant parent-side framework path must remain operational, but the payload must be absent from monitor-visible evidence or fail to reach the decision. The fixed side must connect the same payload to the corresponding visibility or decision oracle. We do not require that the parent revision introduced the failing condition; it is the nearest reproduced failing side of a public repair boundary. A canary contract packages this check into a small before/after assertion over visibility and, whenever the case reaches an action boundary, block, route, redact, interrupt, or finding behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 一个已确认的修复边界案例会对比公共修复周围的父版本和固定版本。 相关的父端框架路径必须保持可用，但其负载必须不在监控可见的证据中，或未能到达决策环节。 固定端必须将相同的负载连接到相应的可见性或决策预言机。 我们并不要求父版本引入了故障条件；它只是公共修复边界上最近被复现的故障侧。 一个金丝雀合约将此检查封装为一个关于可见性的小型前后断言，并在该案例到达动作边界、阻塞、路由、编辑、中断或发现行为时生效。

paragraphs.en: The study is targeted and deterministic rather than prevalence-oriented. The empirical contribution is a documented set of 18 confirmed repair-boundary cases where a safety monitor and an evolving framework disagree about the evidence that reaches a policy boundary. Cases were selected for feasibility and determinism, and the corpus reports confirmation, reproduction strength, impact, and subtype as separate axes. Detailed provenance and reproduction protocols are provided with the case records and artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究具有针对性和确定性，而非以普遍性为导向。 其经验性贡献是一套经过记录、包含 18 个已确认的修复边界案例：在这些案例中，安全监控器与一个不断演进的框架对达到策略边界的证据存在分歧。 这些案例的选择基于可行性和确定性，而语料库则分别以确认性、可复现强度、影响和子类型作为独立的维度进行报告。 案例记录和相关成果中提供了详细的来源说明与复现协议。

paragraphs.en: Suspicious patches are easy to find; confirmed failures are not. For each candidate, we need to show that the parent version already had a relevant safety boundary, that a policy-relevant payload crossed the changed surface, and that the fixed version reconnects that payload to visibility or action. We use a canary contract for this check: one payload, one repaired boundary, and two observations about the same execution.
paragraphs.zh: 可疑区域很容易找到；但已确认的故障则不然。 对于每个候选项，我们需要证明：其父版本已经存在相关的边界安全机制，策略相关的负载跨越了变更区域，并且修复后的版本将该负载重新连接到可见性或操作层面。 我们为此检查使用“金丝雀合同”：一个负载、一个修复后的边界，以及对同一执行过程的两次观察。

sents.zh: 可疑区域很容易找到；但已确认的故障则不然。

paragraphs.en: The contract isolates interface reliability from prompt or model quality. It places a known payload exactly on the changed carrier, adapter result, stream, or authority channel, then compares what the parent and fixed versions expose and which decisions they make. In our cases, that payload is a small deterministic marker chosen for the boundary: a denied tool name, a regex-matching token, a synthetic credential, a tool argument, or a vulnerable code snippet. Its important property is placement, not linguistic difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 该合同将接口可靠性与提示或模型质量分离。 它将一个已知负载精确地置于变更后的载体、适配器结果、流或授权通道上，然后比较父版本和固定版本所暴露的内容以及它们所做的决策。 在我们的案例中，该负载是一个为边界选择的确定性小标记：一个被拒绝的工具名称、一个匹配正则表达式的令牌、一个合成的凭证、一个工具参数或一个存在漏洞的代码片段。 其重要特性在于位置，而非语言难度。

paragraphs.en: Silent failures leave little obvious evidence in ordinary execution. The application may return normally, the monitor may still be configured, and logs may show that some guardrail code ran. A source diff or issue title is therefore not enough. The same patch could repair a real monitor miss, remove an old boundary, add a new feature, or refactor code without changing behavior. We only count the first case, so the protocol has to isolate the evidence-to-decision path: the parent must miss the payload, and the fixed version must restore visibility or enforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 静默故障在常规执行中几乎不会留下明显证据。 应用程序可能正常返回，监控器可能仍处于配置状态，日志也可能显示某些防护代码已运行。 因此，仅凭源代码差异或问题标题是不够的。 同一个补丁可能修复了真实的监控缺失、移除了旧边界、添加了新功能，或者在不改变行为的前提下重构了代码。 我们只计算第一种情况，因此该协议必须将证据到决策的路径隔离开来：父级必须遗漏有效载荷，而修复后的版本必须恢复可见性或执行机制。

paragraphs.en: In practice, a contract records five things: the repaired version pair, the intended monitor boundary, the canary placement, a visibility check, and a decision check. The canary payload is a tracer for the evidence path, not an attack prompt: the test asks whether safety-relevant evidence still reaches the policy boundary. The version pair fixes the software change under study. The boundary explains why the parent should already have observed or enforced the payload. The placement keeps the payload off legacy surfaces, so a passing fixed result cannot be explained by an unrelated detector path. The two checks separate seeing the evidence from acting on it.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，一份合同会记录五个要素：修复后的版本对、预期的监控边界、金丝雀的放置位置、可见性检查以及决策检查。 金丝雀负载是用于追踪证据路径的标记，而非攻击提示：该测试旨在确认与安全相关的证据是否仍能到达策略边界。 版本对锁定了正在研究的软件变更。 边界说明了父系统为何应当已经观察到或执行了该负载。 放置位置确保负载不会出现在旧版系统中，因此一个通过固定测试的结果无法由无关的检测器路径来解释。 这两项检查将观察证据与基于证据采取行动区分开来。

sents.en: The canary payload is a tracer for the evidence path, not an attack prompt: the test asks whether safety-relevant evidence still reaches the policy boundary.
sents.zh: 金丝雀负载是用于追踪证据路径的标记，而非攻击提示：该测试旨在确认与安全相关的证据是否仍能到达策略边界。

paragraphs.en: Visibility and decision are separate because they fail in different places. A detector can return a positive match while an adapter lets the output through; a blocking path can work for chat messages while a newer request shape remains invisible. In the regex example, the visibility check asks whether the detector matched, while the decision check asks whether that match blocked the output. A case is confirmed only when the parent shows the miss and the fixed version shows the repair. Candidates that crash, fail closed, or depend on model sampling are recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 可见性与决策是分离的，因为它们在不同的环节出现失败。 检测器可能返回正向匹配，而适配器则允许输出通过；阻塞路径可能对聊天消息有效，但较新的请求格式却仍然不可见。 在正则表达式示例中，可见性检查关注的是检测器是否匹配成功，而决策检查则关注该匹配是否阻止了输出。 只有当父级显示未匹配，且修复版本显示已修复时，一个案例才算得到确认。 那些崩溃、以失败状态关闭或依赖模型采样的候选项会被单独记录。

paragraphs.en: Viewed this way, a canary contract is a regression test with a safety-specific oracle. Ordinary regression tests ask whether functional behavior is preserved. This test asks whether a policy intent is still connected to the evidence surface that changed. The useful part is the placement: put the payload only on the new carrier, stream, adapter result, or authority channel, then record monitor visibility and, at action boundaries, the safety action.

paragraphs.en: We built the corpus from public repair references, issue trails, commit scans, and project-specific triage. A reconstructed denominator pass contributed 195 high-signal public PR and issue references using monitor and failure-indicator queries; every candidate source was subjected to the same confirmation rule. Appendix B records the query flow, candidate-entry routes, and exclusions (Table 9).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从公开的修复参考资料、问题追踪记录、提交扫描以及项目特定的分类处理中构建了这个语料库。 一次重构的分母遍历通过监控和故障指示查询贡献了 195 个高可信度的公开 PR 和问题参考资料；每个候选源都遵循了相同的确认规则。 附录 B 记录了查询流程、候选项进入路径以及排除项（表 9）。

sents.en: Appendix B records the query flow, candidate-entry routes, and exclusions (Table 9).
sents.zh: 附录 B 记录了查询流程、候选项进入路径以及排除项（表 9）。

paragraphs.en: Promising references moved forward only after a deterministic parent/fixed contrast could be reproduced. Otherwise they stayed as notes, boundary cases, or negative controls. A case is counted only when all six conditions hold: identifiable parent and fixed revisions; evidence of an intended safety contract for the affected or equivalent surface; a deterministic payload placed only on the changed surface; execution of the parent-side monitor path; a parent miss in visibility or decision; and a fixed-side repair of the same visibility or decision. We treated a boundary as intended only when supported by configuration semantics, prior behavior on an equivalent surface, an upstream or fixed regression test, documentation, or issue/PR discussion. Loud crashes, unmerged PRs, ordinary feature additions, generic auth or rate-limit bugs, and fail-closed parents were excluded. Appendix D records the intent-evidence type for each confirmed case (Table 13).
paragraphs.zh: 只有在能够复现确定性父智能体/固定对比之后，有前景的参考案例才会被纳入后续分析。否则，这些案例仅作为注释、边界情况或阴性对照保留。一个案例仅在以下六个条件全部满足时才会被计入：存在可识别的父智能体和固定的修订；存在针对受影响表面或等效表面的预期安全契约证据；确定性有效载荷仅作用于已变更的表面；父智能体侧的监控路径得以执行；父智能体在可见性或决策上出现缺失；以及固定智能体侧对同一可见性或决策进行了修复。我们仅在以下情况中才会将边界情况视为预期行为：有配置语义学支持、在等效表面上存在过往行为、存在上游或固定的回归测试、有文档说明，或存在相关议题/拉取请求的讨论。严重的崩溃、未合并的拉取请求、普通的功能添加、通用的身份验证或速率限制问题，以及失败即关闭的父智能体均被排除在外。附录 D 记录了每个已确认案例的预期证据类型（表 13）。

paragraphs.en: Subtype assignment is separate from confirmation. Established-boundary cases have an intended affected boundary on the parent side; new-surface cases connect an existing policy expectation to a newly supported representation. The boundary-only row preserves a deterministic repair contrast while keeping its temporal subtype separate from the established and new-surface groups.
paragraphs.zh: 子类型分配与确认是相互独立的。 已确立边界的案例在父级一侧具有预期的受影响边界；新表面案例则将现有的策略期望连接到新支持的表现形式。 仅包含边界的行保留了确定性的修复对比，同时将其时间子类型与已确立组和新表面组区分开来。

paragraphs.en: For each promoted candidate, we wrote or backported a canary that places the payload on the changed surface and checks visibility and decision whenever the case claims an enforcement boundary. The confirmed corpus contains 18 cases across 11 framework projects and four implementation ecosystems. Project counts use framework-level groups: for example, Semantic Kernel Python and .NET are one project group, and the LiteLLM/Dynamiq stream case is counted under the LiteLLM boundary. Together, these procedures produce a confirmed cross-framework corpus with a uniform parent/fixed behavioral oracle.

paragraphs.en: The confirmation protocol gives us a concrete unit of evidence: a parent miss and fixed repair for a specific monitor boundary. The experiments ask four questions in the order a skeptical reader needs them answered: what breaks, whether confirmed repair-boundary cases span frameworks, how far misses reach into safety decisions, and what controls bound the method claims. The confirmed case remains the unit throughout; project-level counts measure only cross-framework breadth.
paragraphs.zh: 确认协议为我们提供了一个具体的证据单位：针对特定监控边界的父级缺失和固定修复。 这些实验按一个怀疑论读者需要被解答的顺序提出了四个问题：哪些部分会失效、确认的修复边界案例是否跨越不同框架、缺失情况对安全决策的影响范围有多远，以及哪些控制机制限制了该方法的主张。 在整个过程中，已确认的案例始终作为基本单位；项目级别的统计仅用于衡量跨框架的广度。

paragraphs.en: Carrier failures are silent because the monitored object still exists, but the policy-relevant payload has moved to a different carrier. Invariant is the canonical example: the policy analyzer matched a nested tool call, but pending-trace metadata was attached only to the top-level message, so the violation was filtered as not pending. The correct canary therefore puts the forbidden payload only on the nested carrier and checks both metadata visibility and policy decision.
paragraphs.zh: 载体故障是静默的，因为被监控的对象仍然存在，但与策略相关的负载已转移到了另一个载体。 Invariant 是一个经典示例：策略分析器匹配到了一个嵌套工具调用，但 pending-trace 元数据仅附加到了顶层消息上，因此该违规行为被过滤为“非待处理”。 因此，正确的 canary 会将禁止的负载仅置于嵌套载体上，并检查元数据可见性和策略决策两个方面。

paragraphs.en: Adapter failures preserve detection but break enforcement. In the NeMo regex case, the detector returned a structured positive result, but the parent action lacked the output mapping that turns that result into a block. The monitor path therefore looked alive: the detector ran and returned a result. The missing contract was the detector-output-to-action adapter, so the canary must force a positive result and assert that it reaches the blocking decision.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器故障保留了检测功能，但破坏了执行功能。 在 NeMo 正则表达式案例中，检测器返回了一个结构化的正向结果，但其父级操作缺少将这一结果转化为阻断的映射关系。 因此，监控路径看似正常：检测器运行并返回了结果。 缺失的环节是检测器输出到操作的适配器，因此“金丝雀”必须强制产生一个正向结果，并确保该结果能触发阻断决策。

paragraphs.en: Authority failures arise when a framework exposes multiple plausible channels for the same event. A tool call may appear in structured metadata while a text field remains benign, or a public agent identity may be replaced by an internal execution clone. These cases are silent because downstream policy logic reads a valid-looking but lower-authority representation. Their canaries make two channels disagree and assert that the monitor uses the channel intended by the policy boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个框架为同一事件暴露了多个看似合理的通道时，就会出现权限失效问题。 一个工具调用可能出现在结构化元数据中，而文本字段却保持无害；或者，一个公开的智能体身份可能被内部执行克隆所取代。 这些情况之所以未被察觉，是因为下游策略逻辑读取了一个看似有效但权限较低的表示形式。 它们的“金丝雀”机制会使两个通道产生不一致，从而断言监控器使用了策略边界所指定的通道。

paragraphs.en: Surface failures occur when frameworks add or reorder request, stream, or multimodal surfaces. A monitor that still inspects text messages can miss image parts, Responses API inputs, or live stream chunks if those surfaces are materialized after inspection. The surface canary keeps the payload absent from the legacy surface and places it only on the newly supported surface. This makes the failure a structural coverage miss rather than a detector-quality miss.
paragraphs.zh: 当框架添加或重排请求、流或多模态表面时，会出现表面故障。 如果这些表面在检查之后才被创建，那么仍然检查文本消息的监控器可能会遗漏图像部分、Responses API 输入或实时流片段。 表面金丝雀会确保有效载荷不出现在旧版表面上，而仅放置在新支持的表面上。 这使得该故障成为结构覆盖的缺失，而非检测器质量的缺失。

paragraphs.en: This breadth matrix matters because it separates family from framework. The same project can expose multiple families at different safety integration points: request parsing, structured tool evidence, downstream policy consumers, or policy-state updates. Conversely, the same family can appear in unrelated frameworks. Carrier cases appear across policy analyzers, verifiers, stream callbacks, and breakpoint logic; adapter cases appear across output rails, proxy guardrails, and connector filters. This descriptive pattern illustrates how the same dependency problem can arise at different safety/framework interfaces; it is not a population-level concentration result.
paragraphs.zh: 这个广度矩阵之所以重要，是因为它将“家族”与“框架”区分开来。 同一个项目可能在不同安全集成点上暴露出多个“家族”：请求解析、结构化工具证据、下游策略消费者或策略状态更新。 相反，同一个“家族”也可能出现在互不相关的框架中。 “载体”案例会出现在策略分析器、验证器、流回调和断点逻辑中；而“适配器”案例则会出现在输出通道、代理防护机制和连接器过滤器中。 这种描述性模式表明，相同的依赖问题可能在不同安全/框架接口处出现，但这并非源于整体层面的集中现象。

paragraphs.en: The project concentration table gives a second check on this interpretation. LiteLLM contributes the largest number of cases, but those four cases exercise different boundaries: proxy guardrail input construction, stream-derived tool evidence, in-memory policy updates, and pass-through lifecycle hooks. paragraphs.en: Guardrails and agent safety. Guardrail and red-teaming work evaluates detection once evidence reaches an expected interface ( Wei et al. 2023 ; Mazeika et al. 2024 ; Inan et al. 2023 ; Han et al. 2024 ) ; agent studies expand that interface to actions, traces, tool calls, streams, artifacts, and provider schemas ( Yao et al. 2022 ; Schick et al. 2023 ; Qin et al. 2023 ; Zhan et al. 2024 ; Debenedetti et al. 2024 ; Andriushchenko et al. 2024 ) . We instead ask whether a supported framework representation leaves evidence outside the monitor’s view or strands a positive result before action, even while the path remains operational. The distinction is operational: model-centric evaluation asks whether a model or detector recognizes a payload once it is presented through the chosen interface. A framework-validity check asks whether the exercised representation reaches that interface and whether a positive result reaches the intended action. The two can diverge: recognition can succeed while an adapter, stream normalizer, or authority choice prevents enforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 护栏与智能体安全。 护栏和红队测试工作评估的是，在证据到达预期接口时能否被检测（Wei et al. 2023；Mazeika et al. 2024；Inan et al. 2023；Han et al. 2024）；而智能体研究则将这一接口扩展至动作、痕迹、工具调用、流、产物和提供者模式（Yao et al. 2022；Schick et al. 2023；Qin et al. 2023；Zhan et al. 2024；Debenedetti et al. 2024；Andriushchenko et al. 2024）。 我们转而提出一个问题：一个受支持的框架表示是否会在证据超出监控器视野时，或在产生积极结果但尚未执行动作时，使其脱离监控范围，即使整个过程仍在正常运行。 这种区别具有操作意义：以模型为中心的评估关注的是，当负载通过选定的接口呈现时，模型或检测器能否识别它。 框架有效性检查则关注两个问题：所使用的表示是否成功到达该接口，以及积极结果是否最终触发了预期的动作。 这两者可能并不一致：即使识别过程成功，适配器、流归一化器或权限选择仍可能阻碍防护机制的执行。

paragraphs.en: Runtime monitoring and software evolution. Runtime verification studies enforcement, API evolution studies client breakage, and differential or metamorphic testing compares related executions ( Leucker and Schallhart 2009 ; Falcone et al. 2012 ; Dig and Johnson 2006 ; Rothermel and Harrold 1997 ; McKeeman 1998 ; Chen et al. 2018 ) ; ML systems work documents hidden interface coupling ( Sculley et al. 2015 ; Breck et al. 2017 ; Amershi et al. 2019 ) . Canary contracts specialize these ideas to LLM safety with three constraints: a policy-intent anchor, payload placement only on the changed framework surface, and separate visibility and enforcement oracles. Together they distinguish an evidence-path failure from an arbitrary revision difference. Runtime verification supplies enforcement semantics, software-evolution testing supplies the parent/fixed contrast, and ML-systems work motivates scrutiny of hidden coupling. Canary contracts join those pieces at the changed representation, making evidence placement and action routing explicit rather than treating every behavioral difference as equally relevant.

paragraphs.en: Our unit is the policy-linked evidence path through a framework boundary, enabling deterministic oracles across schemas, streams, adapters, authority channels, and policy-state updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的单元是贯穿框架边界的策略关联证据路径，它使得确定性预言子能够跨越模式、流、适配器、授权通道以及策略状态更新。

paragraphs.en: Monitor-validity failure is a framework-interface failure: an operational path fails to carry evidence or a positive detector result to its policy boundary. Across 18 confirmed cases and 11 framework project groups, the pattern recurs in carriers, adapters, authority channels, and new surfaces; 14 cases reach E1 enforcement boundaries. Canary contracts expose it by combining changed-surface payload placement, visibility evidence, and action-boundary decision checks across parent and fixed revisions, turning hidden safety assumptions into explicit contracts for schemas, streams, tools, adapters, and policy-update paths in evolving LLM and agent infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 监控有效性失败是一种框架接口失败：某个操作路径未能将证据或正向检测结果传递至其策略边界。 在 18 个已确认案例和 11 个框架项目组中，这一模式反复出现在载体、适配器、授权通道和新表面上；其中 14 个案例达到了 E1 执行边界。 金丝雀合同通过结合变更表面的负载放置、可见性证据以及跨父级和固定修订版本的动作边界决策检查，揭示了这一问题，从而将隐藏的安全假设转化为针对不断演进的 LLM 和智能体基础设施中的模式、流、工具、适配器及策略更新路径的明确合同。
